name: Gadget
tagline: Tech you can try before you buy and get fixed after
niche: Electronics store and repair centre: phones, laptops, audio, repairs

seo.title: Gadget — electronics store and repairs in Tashkent
seo.description: Phones, laptops, headphones and smartwatches with an official warranty. Trade-in, instalments and a repair centre with a 15-minute diagnosis.
seo.answer: Gadget is an electronics store and repair centre at 15 Amir Temur Ave, Tashkent, open daily 10:00–21:00. Phones from 2,900,000 UZS, laptops from 7,400,000 UZS, 6–12 month instalments and trade-in for your old device. Diagnosis is free; screen replacement starts at 450,000 UZS.

listing.description: A site for an electronics store, repair centre or gadget brand. A dot-matrix headline that scatters from the cursor, products as spec cards, the repair service as a terminal log and numbers on an LED board.

sections.title: Tech without surprises
sections.subtitle: Switch on and try anything in store. Official warranty, interest-free instalments and a repair centre one floor up, so if something breaks you won’t have far to go.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A showroom where everything is switched on
sections.text: We don’t keep devices in boxes: every model sits on a table, charged and unlocked. Our staff get no commission on pricier models, so they’ll tell you honestly if last year’s phone is enough. Everything comes with an official warranty, and we service it ourselves.

sections.label: Repairs
sections.title: Repairs, step by step, with a report

items.title: Drop-off
items.text: We note the fault and give you a receipt with an order number.

items.title: Diagnosis
items.text: 15 minutes while you wait, free. We quote before any work starts.

items.title: Repair
items.text: Original or certified parts, your choice.

items.title: Testing
items.text: We test the screen, cameras, signal and battery against a checklist.

items.title: Pick-up
items.text: We message you on Telegram when it’s ready. 6-month warranty on the work.

items.quote: They talked me out of the expensive model. I bought last year’s and can’t tell the difference.
items.author: Sherzod

items.quote: They replaced the screen in an hour and a half while I had a coffee downstairs.
items.author: Kamila

items.quote: I traded in my old laptop, paid the difference and left with a new one the same day.
items.author: Bobur

items.a: 6 or 12 months interest-free through partner banks and Uzum Nasiya. You only need your passport; a decision takes 10 minutes.
We value your old device in front of you and put that amount towards a new one.

items.q: Is there a warranty on repairs?
items.a: Yes, 6 months on the work and the parts fitted. We keep your receipt on file, so it doesn’t matter if you lose the paper.
In Tashkent by courier the same day, across Uzbekistan in 1–3 days. You can check the device in front of the courier.

items.q: Do you repair devices bought elsewhere?
items.a: Yes, any device. Diagnosis is free even if you decide not to go ahead.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Ask what’s in stock
sections.text: Send us the model on Telegram and we’ll tell you if it’s on display and hold it for a day. For repairs, send a photo of the damage.

sections.label: Shop
sections.title: Shop
sections.text: Add to cart and check out — we will call to confirm and deliver.
